entries.text: New row Croatia — HIO & national competitions: every English paper on hsin.hr 2001–2015 (Croatian Olympiad in Informatics, Final Exams, National and Regional Competitions, 2010 School Competition, 2012 Junior Olympiad), 305 tasks; 2013 is no longer served
